name: 1706 Prairie Avenue — George Glessner Georgian townhouse (district draft; refined by T-1871)

function.note: The 1911 sheet marks the building 'D' (dwelling): '3B brick dwelling (D), the south unit of the block; divided from 1700 by a party line that does not run to the alley, so 1700 and 1706 stand on one lot'. Carried to 1904 on the T-1840 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2334, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1871 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 20 trace (s20fp-1700-b1/p1), the T-1840 census (s20-1706-f) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20-015 (George Glessner Georgian townhouse); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-16-18-west-2334).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1840 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 1706 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_1700 (data/street_grid/1904.json), west side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 16th to 18th Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 20).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 33.000, v -10.500 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check, so its own fit residual, 2.46 m RMS on its control crossings, is all that is claimed. Rotation -0.58 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the traced sheet and the 1904 parcel by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: '3B' printed on the 1911 sheet: 3 full storeys.

construction.note: The register reads the map's colours as 'brick'.

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The mirrored partner to 1700 with its own entrance: the south unit (p1 of s20fp-1700-b1) under the same low hip, its door at the outer (south) end, so the pair reads as two houses and one composition. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 3555515488 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
